Celebrities Discuss Societal Views on Third Marriages

Indian television celebrities Hina Khan and Rubina Dilaik discussed societal perceptions of third marriages, specifically referencing actor Aamir Khan's situation. Khan stated that third marriages are 'not considered very good in society.' Dilaik echoed this sentiment, suggesting that such unions are not viewed favorably within their community. The discussion highlighted a perceived social stigma attached to multiple marriages.
